confidence_notes: Food and hostel anchors use Udaipur-specific 2026 price aggregates with modest contributor samples. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain, estimated from their local price relationship to beer and checked against a tourist-rooftop menu. Hotel anchors are holistic estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; Udaipur-specific price data was available for restaurant basics and hostels.
